metadata.description: Common developer toolkit — reusable, project-agnostic Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: test-utils
plugins.description: E2E and browser-debugging utilities (enabled by default): gen-e2e-test authors self-contained Playwright tests with API reports, gen-e2e-record turns codegen recordings into tests, and dev-browser provides agent-side UI debugging.

plugins.name: analysis-estimation
plugins.description: Analysis & estimation suite (enabled by default): rfp-requirement-analysis → rfp-architecture-design → rfp-sa-bdd forms a traceable RFP/SOW pipeline; cold-estimation delivers method-based initial estimates with risk effort for new and existing systems; quality-orchestrator runs a writer→reviewer→fixer checklist loop.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Everyday dev toolkit: token-usage diagnosis, prompt tuning, goal setting, delegation, long-running strategic execution, wayfinder decision maps, and plain-language or visual explainers.

plugins.name: common-lab
plugins.description: Common Lab (experimental): 16 TypeSafe Jev lab skills — a Jev request router (suggest-jev), Jev setup (init-jev), yes/no gate (jev-gate), list pick (jev-pick, incl. a before-stopping check), rubric score (jev-score), Jev opportunity finder (jever), jev-browser (dev-browser with Jev element picking), an ask-the-user check (is-truely-need-to-ask-user-jev), and Jev overlays that add Jev readings to define-goal, strategic-advance, contract, review, think, wait-what, wayfinder, and cold-estimation (*-jever). Graduated skills now live in the stable plugins: grilling, domain-modeling, research, prototype, wait-what, wayfinder, show-me in common; think, contract, seal, review in baransu. The Lab estimate, define-goal and better-prompts variants were retired in 0.9.0, the Lab strategic-advance variant in 0.10.0; 0.19.0 retired ui-jever, seal-jever, show-me-jever, none-stop-jever, and both Lab delegate variants with the executor agent; use analysis-estimation:cold-estimation, common:define-goal, common:better-prompts, common:strategic-advance, common:delegate, baransu:ui / baransu:draw, baransu:seal and common:show-me. Invoke as /common-lab:<skill>. Enabled by default once installed; disable with `claude plugin disable common-lab` if unwanted.

plugins.name: linkstart
plugins.description: LinkStart v1 Preview integration (enabled by default): one link-start workflow reconnects an interactive HTML or localhost app to the same Claude Code session or Codex thread through the exact bundled Runtime, private session context, and one-call arm/respond monitor flow.

plugins.name: common-mod
plugins.description: Claude Code mods (Claude only; enabled by default; no slash commands): recall — typing # in the prompt box or the 回想 button opens a band above the prompt to search past Claude Code, desktop and Cowork conversations; pressing one puts its #chat:<id> token in the prompt box, and sending the prompt attaches that conversation as quoted context; side — the 側聊 button opens a side-chat pane docked beside the transcript like the diff panel (answers from a fork of this conversation, no tools), with a button to go on as a branch in a new window (switch model there, use tools), whose 帶回主線 sends a summary back to the main session; bar — a two-rail status line above the prompt: folder, model and animated ctx, 5h and 7d gauges, then buttons for 側聊, 回想, diff, artifacts, 看不懂 (/common:wait-what), 畫給我看 (/common:show-me) and 下一步 (next-step suggestions put in the prompt box as a draft); the terminal and the desktop each draw it their own way: the terminal with neon gauges and chips, the desktop with native buttons and SVG gauges and without diff and artifacts; 看不懂 and 畫給我看 fall back to a project's own wait-what and show-me skills, and a project adds its own buttons in .claude/common-mod.json.
